a2-15-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Is Lucía Going Back?
a2-15-01.scenario: At the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Lucía has told her friends that she has to go back to Spain. Carlos's sister Ana calls you and asks why Lucía decided to go back. Lucía received some news.
a2-15-01.prompt: Tell Ana that Lucía decided to go back to Spain because she received some news.
a2-15-01.target: Lucía decidió volver a España porque recibió una noticia.
a2-15-01.english: Lucía decided to go back to Spain because she received some news.
a2-15-01.canDo: I can explain why a completed past event happened using porque and the pretérito indefinido.

a2-15-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The News
a2-15-02.scenario: The evening after the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Carlos's sister Ana calls you and asks what happened to Lucía. Lucía received some news from Spain and so she decided to go back.
a2-15-02.prompt: Tell Ana that Lucía received some news and that is why she decided to go back to Spain.
cues: Say the result, with por eso
a2-15-02.target: Lucía recibió una noticia, por eso decidió volver a España.
a2-15-02.english: Lucía received some news, so she decided to go back to Spain.
a2-15-02.canDo: I can describe consequences of completed past events using por eso.

a2-15-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Cause and Consequence
a2-15-03.scenario: Back in the apartment after the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Meg asks you why everybody was sad. Lucía received some news and decided to go back, and the whole group was sad because they understood the situation.
a2-15-03.prompt: Tell Meg what Lucía's news caused and why everybody was sad.
cues: Say what happened to Lucía and the result
a2-15-03.target: Lucía recibió una noticia, por eso decidió volver. Todos estuvimos tristes porque entendimos la situación.
a2-15-03.english: Lucía received some news, so she decided to go back. We were all sad because we understood the situation.
a2-15-03.canDo: I can connect causes and consequences using porque and por eso.

a2-15-04.title: Communicative Challenge: How I Felt
a2-15-04.scenario: At the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Carlos's sister Ana calls you and asks how you felt about Lucía's news. You smiled because you remembered the trip, and you cried because you understood the situation.
a2-15-04.prompt: Tell Ana that you smiled because you remembered the trip, and that you understood the situation, so you cried.
cues: Say what you understood and the result
a2-15-04.target: Sonreí porque recordé el viaje. Entendí la situación, por eso lloré.
a2-15-04.english: I smiled because I remembered the trip. I understood the situation, so I cried.
a2-15-04.canDo: I can explain the causes and consequences of a goodbye using the pretérito indefinido.

a2-15-05.title: Communicative Challenge: An Unexpected Goodbye
a2-15-05.scenario: The week after the picnic in the park in Hanoi, Carlos's sister Ana calls and asks you to tell her the story. Lucía received some news and decided to go back to Spain; you smiled because you remembered the trip, and you cried because you understood the situation.
a2-15-05.prompt: Tell Ana the story: what Lucía's news led to, and how and why you felt.
cues: Say what Lucía received and decided
a2-15-05.target: Lucía recibió una noticia, por eso decidió volver a España. Sonreí porque recordé el viaje. Lloré porque entendí la situación.
a2-15-05.english: Lucía received some news, so she decided to go back to Spain. I smiled because I remembered the trip. I cried because I understood the situation.
a2-15-05.canDo: I can recount an unexpected goodbye and explain its causes, consequences and emotions.

a2-15-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Because and So
a2-15-consolidation.scenario: Carlos's sister Ana calls you after the picnic in the park in Hanoi. Lucía received some news and decided to go back to Spain; you were sad, so you wrote Lucía a message.
a2-15-consolidation.prompt: Tell Ana why Lucía decided to go back, and that you were sad, so you wrote Lucía a message.
cues: Say why Lucía decided to go back
Say what you did because you were sad
a2-15-consolidation.target: Lucía decidió volver porque recibió una noticia. Estuve triste, por eso escribí un mensaje.
a2-15-consolidation.english: Lucía decided to go back because she received some news. I was sad, so I wrote a message.
a2-15-consolidation.canDo: I can use porque and por eso with the pretérito indefinido.
